command.name: Fiery Bonds
verbatim: Each Round: 25% chance to Taunt 3 Enemies in any lane for 2 round(s). This chance is doubled against targets afflicted with Burn.
Even-numbered Rounds: Deal Physical Damage to 1 Enemy within adjacency (Damage Rate: +120%).

vanguard.name: Warrior's Resilience
vanguard.verbatim: At Level 16+ and deployed in the Vanguard, reduce Damage Received by -8%. Increase Tactical Damage Dealt by +16% of the Ally deployed in the Left Flank.

habits.name: Ancestral Shield
verbatim: Start of Round 1: Reduce your Physical and Tactical Damage Received by -20% for 3 rounds.
Start of Round 4: Increase your Recovery Received by +25.5% until the end of combat.

habits.name: Battle Leader
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Increase Physical Damage Dealt (excluding Basic Attacks) by +21.25% of 1 Ally in any lane (prioritizes the Right Flank) until the end of combat.

habits.name: Eclipse Cover
habits.verbatim: Rounds 3-7: 21% chance to grant Advantage (+20%) to the Ally with the most troops and afflict Weakened (-20%) on the Enemy with the most troops. Each effect lasts for 2 round(s).

habits.name: Blazing Onslaught
habits.verbatim: Start of Round 1: Increase Fire Damage Received of 1 Enemy in any lane (prioritizes the Left Flank) and Physical Damage Received (excluding Basic Attacks) of 1 Enemy in any lane (prioritizes the Right Flank) by +30.6% for 3 round(s).

habits.name: Skyward Titan
verbatim: Each Round: 30% chance to gain 1 stack of Bulwark (Max 5 Stacks) until the end of combat.
Each stack of Bulwark increases your Strength by +5% and reduces your Physical and Tactical Damage Received by -2%.
Gain 3rd Stack of Bulwark: Deal Physical Damage (Damage Rate: +100%) to 1 Enemy in the same lane.
